mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (UNRATE > 4.0%) with t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (indicated by sharp industrial production decline), S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and higher input costs.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) with t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (indicated by strong job growth in PAYEMS), corporate hiring costs rise but productivity gains support higher profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
